name: Mist Walker
theme: A covert Nordic mist raider who uses coastal fog, silent movement, concealed tools, and precise strikes to infiltrate guarded areas, bypass hazards, and expose vulnerable targets.
visualIdentity: Layered gray and smoke-blue cloak, weathered leather armor, muted iron fittings, twin Mistfang Seax Knives, concealed infiltration tools, and restrained silver-gray mist effects.
consistency: Use the same face, hairstyle, cloak silhouette, leather armor pattern, Mistfang knife design, tool placement, muted iron fittings, and silver-gray mist palette across all assets.

starterAbilities.name: Mist Step
starterAbilities.description: Move through cover and fog with exceptional speed and concealment.

starterAbilities.name: Veiled Strike
starterAbilities.description: Deliver a precise hidden strike while remaining difficult to track.

starterAbilities.name: Fogwire Trap
starterAbilities.description: Deploy a concealed trap to hinder enemy movement and awareness.
